title: Mobile App Franchise Opportunity
name: Goodday, 3 Franchisees, Est'd in 2023, Bucharest HQ
description: Goodday is a mobile app and a ready-made business model for launching a local privilege club in a city. - The platform connects users with local businesses, including restaurants, cafés, shops, services, and other establishments, providing subscribers with special offers, privileges, and unique experiences. - Franchisees receive a ready-made digital platform, brand, technology, marketing model, and tools for connecting with local partners and attracting users. - The main sources of revenue are user subscriptions, commercial promotion for partners, participation in themed festivals, and other B2B tools available through the platform. - Goodday combines a digital platform, subscription model, local businesses, and culinary festivals to create a scalable city club format that can be launched in different cities and countries. - No special registrations are required for the business. Revenue expectations: - Goodday is a digital-first business model that does not require a large office, extensive infrastructure, or a high number of employees to operate a franchise. - This lean operating structure allows franchise partners to keep fixed costs relatively low while focusing resources on user acquisition, partner development, marketing, and revenue generation. - With lower overheads and a scalable digital platform, franchisees can build and manage their territory efficiently, creating the potential for strong revenue and attractive profitability as the local user base and partner network grow.
